Anna has practiced basketball for three years and won a prize last term. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Sam always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The bank is in a central location.
Anna believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Traffic banks up before the flyover.

Anna keeps a small dog at home and feeds it every morning. Little by little, things began to change. On Thursday evenings, Anna reviews the notes from class. For example, the minibar prices made her laugh.

People around Anna often share different ideas about the bus stop. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Also, the whole town joins the spring festival.
The ticket office has become an important part of daily life. Anna bought a hat online because it was much cheaper. The bus stop looked quieter than usual that evening.
